code_refs.description: Raw caller_model resolution: exact model_id match wins before substring fallback, and unknown ids are rejected only after raw resolution fails.
Unresolvable caller_model strings are rejected before any budget math, and rejection guidance uses the bounded available-model sample.
Normalization fallback is transport-layer only: strip a trailing parenthetical qualifier, fold spaces/underscores to hyphens, and lowercase the result.
The transport wrapper resolves raw caller_model first, falls back to normalized resolution only on failure, and labels successful fallback as allow-normalized with a soft warning.
The server-response hook injects the surfaced soft warning into result.costGateWarning.
tools/list schema text documents the tolerated caller_model format for clients.
Parenthetical client qualifier fallback is accepted and surfaces allow-normalized telemetry.
Space and underscore separators are normalized to hyphens before fallback resolution succeeds.
Unknown models remain rejected after normalization; normalization never turns an unresolvable caller_model into an allowed zero-cost call.
